transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Um... hi. I guess... I just came in because I keep feeling like I ruin things for everybody. Like I'm a fake in my apprenticeship. I just feel like I let my family down, and the younger apprentices too... over stuff that I know other people would probably just fix and move on from. So... yeah. That's it, really.
Do you find yourself worrying about lots of different parts of your life, even when nothing specific has gone wrong?
Um... no, not really. I don't think I worry about everything. Just... the things I actually messed up. That's all.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most days?
Um... yeah, I guess so. Most days. Just... really down.

Yeah... I mean, I kind of said it before. I just... I feel like a fake at work. Like I'm letting my family down, and the newer apprentices... just over stupid mistakes that I can't seem to get past. So... yeah. Worthless, I guess.
Have you had thoughts that you’d be better off dead?

Um... no, not like... I don't have a plan to hurt myself or anything. Just... sometimes, like when I'm driving home after class, or just lying awake at night... I get these thoughts that... maybe it would just be easier if I didn't wake up tomorrow. But I wouldn't do anything.
Did these feelings start after a particular stressful event?
Um... no, not really. I don't think so. Nothing out of the ordinary happened, it just... kind of started. I don't know.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah, I guess so. Um... lately, I just... I don't know. I can walk right past my sketchbook and not even care. And I've been skipping volleyball... ignoring texts from my volunteer group. I just don't feel much of anything about it anymore. Which is weird, because... those used to be the things I actually liked doing.
Have you been moving or speaking more slowly than usual?

I guess so. Um... mostly just on the job. I catch myself moving slow. Like... it just takes extra effort to climb down for a fitting, or... even just to answer the foreman when he asks me something. A couple of the guys asked if I was sick or hungover. But... I don't know. I'm just slow lately, I guess.
Before this started, have you generally been this hard on yourself for most of your life?
Um... no, not really. I mean... I've always had days where I get down on myself, I guess. But... not like this. It's different now.
